intended_application: Marketing content ideation and first-draft generation
business_need: Reduce the time marketing employees spend generating campaign ideas, product descriptions, and first-draft promotional content
users_stakeholders: Marketing employees, brand managers, product teams, legal reviewers
capabilities_constraints: Small internal technology team, limited AI engineering resources, standard cloud-based collaboration tools, and a requirement for human review before external publication
risk_consequence_context: Poor or inaccurate generated content could create brand or reputational risk, but drafts can be reviewed and corrected before publication and the consequences are generally more reversible than in regulated financial-services policy guidance
management_question: Should management test generative AI as a supervised tool for marketing ideation and first-draft content creation?
